race.comment: BRAVISSIMA (14) has a good record over the Randwick mile. Was three weeks between runs on the heavy surface with a floundering ninth over this trip here with the 3kg apprentice aboard. Can handle the class rise and run a big race with just the 53.5kg. Value chance with Rachel King aboard. ELECTRIC IMPULSE (7) talented mare who comes up from Victoria and ready to peak. Brings the right form to the table after closing late when fourth in the LR Winter Cship over 1600m at Flemington. Stalks the speed and expected to go close. THE CREATOR (13) holding his form and will relish a firmer surface after being nailed late by Cold Brew when second over 1600m here last start. Drops further in weight and capable of taking this out. NARBOLD (10) back to the mile for the first time in three starts with J Mac taking the reins. Savaged the line in the heavy going when third over 1400m at this track. Can race closer today and expected to figure prominently. SEVEN'S (15) drops in weight and maps well.
